meta.name: Triage social crisis mentions with Google Gemini and webhook routing

name: Autonomous Brand Reputation & Social Crisis Alert Agent

parameters.content:
## Autonomous Brand Reputation & Social Crisis Alert Agent

### How it works

This workflow ingests a social media mention either from a webhook or a manual test seed, enriches it with PR matrix context, and sends it to an AI triage agent. The AI returns structured crisis analysis, which is routed by severity into executive alerting, support escalation, or community archive handling. All routed outcomes are merged into a consolidated crisis audit and then synced to a final PR and crisis ledger.

### Setup steps

- Configure the inbound webhook URL in the social listening or monitoring tool that will send mention data.
- Set up Google Gemini credentials for the AI triage node and verify the structured output parser matches the expected crisis fields.
- Review the code nodes for the PR matrix, alert formatting, escalation formatting, and final ledger sync logic, updating any brand-specific criteria or destinations.
- Configure any external ledger, database, ticketing, or notification credentials referenced by the final sync code before activating the workflow.

### Customization

Adjust the severity routing rules, PR risk matrix, follower-count thresholds, and formatted alert templates to match the organization’s crisis response policy.

## Capture social mention

This left-side intake cluster supports both manual testing and live webhook ingestion, then attaches the initial PR matrix and brand context needed for downstream analysis.

## Analyze crisis risk

This AI cluster uses Gemini and a structured parser to classify the social mention, assess crisis severity, and produce machine-readable PR triage output.

## Route by severity

This decision node branches the structured AI result into the appropriate incident handling path based on the detected severity level.

## Format routed response

This vertical branch cluster formats high-risk executive war-room alerts, support escalations, or lower-risk community archive records, then consolidates all paths into a single audit stream.

## Sync crisis ledger

This final isolated node records the consolidated crisis audit result to the PR and crisis ledger or other configured system of record.
